WITH sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_ex_staff, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS sale_days
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28' AND s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1),
refunds AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28' AND s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1),
cur AS (SELECT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sales_net - coalesce(refund_net,0) DESC) AS rnk,
  rank() OVER (ORDER BY sales_ex_staff - coalesce(refund_net,0) DESC) AS rnk_ex_staff,
  rank() OVER (ORDER BY (sales_net - coalesce(refund_net,0))/sale_days DESC) AS rnk_perday,
  sales.store_id, cur.store_name, sale_days, round(sales_net - coalesce(refund_net,0),2) AS net_sales
FROM sales JOIN cur USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN refunds USING (store_id) ORDER BY rnk

WITH period AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2),
sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN period p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1),
refunds AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN period p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1),
cur AS (SELECT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period,
  rank() OVER (ORDER BY sales_net - coalesce(refund_net, 0) DESC) AS net_sales_rank,
  sales.store_id, cur.store_name, round(sales_net - coalesce(refund_net, 0), 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM sales JOIN cur USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN refunds USING (store_id) ORDER BY net_sales_rank
